scoring_rubric.Strong: Pattern is explicitly specified, has a named CI lane, test, or concrete kernel/domain enforcement mechanism, and is traceable to a kernel/domain entity.
scoring_rubric.Adequate: Pattern is present at design level but lacks enforcement lane, SLO contract, or explicit saturation boundary.
scoring_rubric.Partial: Pattern is mentioned in passing or scoped to a single layer; cross-cutting enforcement absent.
scoring_rubric.Gap: Pattern is not addressed in the spec; explicit risk if not added before GA.

verification_limitations: This audit scores design maturity and named enforcement mechanisms; it does not prove runtime behavior unless a score cites a CI lane, test, or concrete kernel/domain contract.

The portfolio slice is intentionally scoped to the core product subset listed in products_audited. Connect and Enterprise subproduct specs exist and are explicitly excluded from this scorecard until a follow-up audit scores them.
_meta.scope_note: Core-product subset audit only. The excluded Connect and Enterprise machine-readable product specs exist and are not scored in this artifact; they require a separate product-family scorecard before portfolio-level claims include them.

cell_isolation.evidence: Cell aggregate with TenantDensityClass (shared|dedicated|sovereign|air-gapped); per-cell Postgres cluster; Envoy x-oya-cell header; per-cell IAM default-deny; monthly chaos drills; per-cell network ACL blocks cross-cell by default.
gaps: Design names the isolation shape, but no dedicated CI/test proves per-cell network ACL and cross-cell default-deny behavior yet.

idempotency.evidence: Idempotency-Key header on every mutating REST+gRPC; outbox deduplication 24h; cloud-init deduped on instance_id; idempotency_key on every billing event; MeterEvent idempotency_key field.
gaps: Design names the idempotency contract, but no PRD-linked CI lane proves every mutating surface carries and enforces the key.

backpressure.evidence: 429+Retry-After on cell capacity exhaustion; observability ingest dead-letter at 95% lag; bulk endpoint max 1000 resources / 100000 objects; batch dispatch windows (5s/60s/1s); LB control loop slows under metric pressure.
gaps: Design names shed points, but the cell-router and ingest backpressure paths are not yet tied to a negative-path integration test.

observability_4_golden_signals.evidence: Latency p99 SLOs on every API surface; availability % SLOs; MetricStream+LogStream+TraceStream; OTel collector; VictoriaMetrics+Loki+Tempo. Traffic signal present via MeterEvent. Error signal implicit in SLO breach detection.
gaps: Saturation SLO per cell resource dimension (CPU/mem/net/IOPS) not specified as a field in CellCapacity.
No explicit error-budget burn-rate alert contract (fast-burn 5x/1h page; slow-burn 1x/6h ticket).

hot_key_resilience.evidence: Bulk endpoint caps exist. Cursor-based pagination. Batch dispatch windows prevent hot-write amplification.
gaps: No per-tenant request-rate quota at cell-routing layer for STS/IAM hot paths.
No shuffle-sharding on (tenant_id, resource_kind) for IAM STS fanout.
Hot-partition mitigation for ClickHouse billing aggregation under single-tenant spike not documented.

stuck_loop_circuit_breakers.evidence: Foundry cloud.capacity.rebalance capability is autonomy-bounded (T2); cloud.iam.audit-narrow requires human approval at T2; Argo Rollouts metric-gated rollback; audit-chain on every mutation enables forensic replay.
gaps: No explicit max-retry budget defined on outbox consumer for cloud.resource_created events.
No dead-letter TTL or circuit-breaker threshold specified for Kafka consumer lag per topic.

insecure_by_default_avoidance.evidence: IMDSv2-only (greenfield A11); TLS everywhere via rustls; IPv6 from day 1; OpenBao for secrets (ADR-0043); per-cell host hardening; Cosign+Trivy+SBOM supply-chain attestation (ADR-0039); Cedar default-deny cross-cell IAM; KCMVP/FIPS-140-3/EAL-4+ HSM per pack; MinIO REJECTED (AGPL).

vendor_lock_in_avoidance.evidence: Every external dep behind adapter trait (KVM/Firecracker/Ceph/OVN/FRR/OpenTofu/OpenBao/Harbor). cargo-deny denylist. oya-foundry-fitness-license CI lane. MinIO REJECTED. OpenTofu over Terraform (ADR-0050). Linkerd as Istio fallback (ADR-0044).

worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.gap: Stuck-loop circuit-breakers missing on LLM agent capability loops
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.detail: Foundry has no max-retry budget on T1 capability invocations; Ontology has no max-retry on kinetic layer mutations; Workflow max_retry_budget is referenced in patches but not a first-class schema field. A runaway LLM agent can loop indefinitely on any of these surfaces.
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.recommended_fix: Add max_retry_budget: u32 + retry_backoff_policy: ExponentialBackoff to CapabilityRun, WorkflowStep (side-effect class), and OntologyActionInvocation. Add circuit-breaker threshold: N consecutive failures closes circuit for TTL seconds, emits circuit_opened audit row.

worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.gap: Hot-key / hot-entity amplification not rate-limited at API layer
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.detail: Foundry has no per-tenant capability-call rate limit; Workflow Studio has no per-definition concurrent-editor cap; Ontology has no per-tenant action-invocation rate limit. A single tenant can amplify to provider-rate-limit saturation or unbounded CRDT merge fanout.
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.recommended_fix: Add per-tenant token-bucket rate limiter at Foundry capability API, Workflow Studio save API, and Ontology action API. Expose rate_limit_remaining header. Return 429+Retry-After on breach. Add shuffle-sharding on (tenant_id, capability_id) for IAM/STS hot paths in Cloud.

worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.gap: Terminal shed strategy absent when all LLM providers degrade
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.detail: Foundry now specifies 95% Run-queue shedding and alternate-provider failover, but still lacks the terminal all-providers-degraded behavior. Without that final state, capability runs may still queue indefinitely after every configured provider circuit is open.
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.recommended_fix: Define ProviderRunQueue with max_depth: usize and shed_policy: {action: DeadLetter | Reject, threshold_pct: u8}. Add all_providers_degraded circuit: after N consecutive cross-provider failures, fail-fast all capability runs with 503+Retry-After for TTL. Emit all_providers_degraded audit event.

worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.gap: 3 of 4 golden signals missing in Workflow Studio (traffic, errors, saturation)
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.detail: Only latency (editor_tti_cold_p99_seconds, save_round_trip_p99_ms) and availability (editor_availability_slo_pct) are defined. No traffic signal (active sessions/s), no error-rate signal (failed saves/min), no saturation signal (CRDT merges/s vs cell capacity). Violates Google SRE 4 golden signals requirement.
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.recommended_fix: Add metrics: active_editor_sessions_per_cell (traffic), definition_save_error_rate_per_min (errors), crdt_merge_queue_depth_pct (saturation). Wire to oya-foundry-fitness-perf-budget lane. Add saturation SLO: shed new collab connections when crdt_merge_queue_depth_pct > 90.

worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.gap: Error-budget burn-rate alert contract missing across all products
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.detail: Every product defines SLO targets (availability %, latency p99) but none defines an error-budget burn-rate alert policy. Per Google SRE: fast-burn (5x rate in 1h) should page on-call; slow-burn (1x rate in 6h) should file a ticket. Without this, teams discover SLO exhaustion only at end-of-month.
worst_5_gaps_across_portfolio.recommended_fix: Add error_budget_policy to each product's observability contract: {fast_burn_multiplier: 5, fast_burn_window_hours: 1, fast_burn_action: Page, slow_burn_multiplier: 1, slow_burn_window_hours: 6, slow_burn_action: Ticket}. Implement via oya-cloud-observability-kernel alerting rule template. CI lane oya-foundry-fitness-error-budget-policy validates presence per product SLO.
